review.theoryObservation: All26 whole outcomes and all28 actual MCQ options/whys freshly derived. One valid procedure: count all equally likely physical outcomes, count favourable physical outcomes, write favourable over total and simplify if possible. Colour/letter/numbered-property/both/either/inclusive-total cases are useful applications of that same route, not six invented methods. Two multipart examples cover unequal category counts/repeated physical labels plus inclusive and both/either comparisons. Core three steps unchanged and all26 solutions agree, with no artificial procedure labels. The intro explicitly supplies uniform physical-card draws across retained questions; random bag draw supports E0. Stage3 ChanceA governs, basic factors/prime identification explicitly Stage3. No multistage product, formal set/union/intersection algorithm, probability decimal/percent requirements or complement-rule teaching added. Standard event/P wording already source-compatible and familiar.
review.sourceObservation: Personally read all five complete actual sources and surrounding start/end lines. Direct Stage3 ChanceA2951–2983 explicitly supplies equally likely outcomes and fraction probability; direct factors743–788 supplies property identification, with source factor12 illustrative omission recorded (bank correctly includes12). Original Probability1 indirect554–682 contains full rule/all three filled examples/complete KeyIdeas closing635/full Foundation1–3;885–892 full factor task;917–955 full card17/18 and closing table. Viewed all six actual original PNG19–22/41/42 independently. Original P(black) in blue-marble answer is retained in evidence, not copied; composite21 whole four scaffolds/MD associations recorded honestly, not claimed filled or unseen DOCX error. Count/fraction style borrowed within Stage3 scope; word-letter/inclusive packs are honest elementary adaptations, no identical filled source claim. No missing images/gaps or new source waiver. Current final source/hash/dependency/whole-coverage bindings verified.
